# `find_in_set`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the index (1-based) of the given string (`str`) in the comma-delimited list (`str_array`).
Returns 0, if the string was not found or if the given string (`str`) contains a comma.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
find_in_set(str, str_array)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- find_in_set, example 1
> SELECT find_in_set('ab','abc,b,ab,c,def');
3
```
